reason: Most of my orders come from regular buyers who just call me, and I quote them from memory in two minutes. IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and enquiries, so paying Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for another website and a quote desk doesn't solve a problem I actually have.
objection: My buyers won't visit a website, they phone or WhatsApp me. Rs 5,000 a month is Rs 60,000 a year on top of my IndiaMART fees, and I don't see how many new orders it will bring, from a small remote studio I have never met.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a trader like me that it brought real new orders beyond IndiaMART, and a much lower monthly fee or a free trial on my own enquiries before I pay setup.
